purpose: Show degree by comparing it with an illustrative result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain form + ほど; noun + ほど; な-adjective + なほど
I was so surprised that I could not speak.
This bag is light enough for even a child to carry.
I laughed so much that tears came to my eyes.
formation: Plain form + ほど; noun + ほど; な-adjective + なほど
restrictions: The result often serves as an expressive scale, not a literal measurement.
mistake: Do not translate every ほど as approximately; this use describes intensity.
